name: Vibe Index
description: A project discovery and sharing platform for developers and creators. Browse, submit, and discuss software projects across 12 categories.

/.description: Home page — browse, search, and filter the full project directory

searchBar.agent_instructions: Type a search query to find projects by name, description, or tags. Press Enter or wait for results to load automatically.

categoryFilter.agent_instructions: Click a category button to filter projects. Categories include: AI & Machine Learning, Developer Tools, Web Apps, Mobile Apps, APIs & Backend, Games, E-Commerce, Productivity, Social & Community, Education, Finance, Design & Creative.

pricingFilter.agent_instructions: Click to filter by pricing: free, freemium, paid, or open-source.

sortSelector.agent_instructions: Change sort order: newest, most liked, or most followed.

projectCard.agent_instructions: Click a project card to view its full details, including description, links, tags, and community discussion.

/submit.description: Submit a new project for listing on Vibe Index. Users start with 3 free listing credits.

urlInput.description: Enter the project URL to submit
urlInput.agent_instructions: Enter the full URL of the project website (e.g. https://example.com). The system will fetch and analyze the site using AI to extract metadata, generate descriptions, and suggest categories.

submitButton.agent_instructions: Click to submit the URL. This starts an AI-powered analysis job. You will be shown a draft to review and edit before the project goes live.

/subscribe.description: Subscribe to email digests for new projects in selected categories

categoryCheckboxes.agent_instructions: Check one or more category checkboxes to receive email digests about new projects in those categories.

frequencySelector.agent_instructions: Select how often to receive digest emails: daily, weekly, or monthly.

subscribeButton.agent_instructions: Click to subscribe. Requires a logged-in account. You will receive curated project digest emails at the selected frequency.

/project/:id.description: Project detail page showing full information and community discussion

likeButton.agent_instructions: Click to like the project. Requires a logged-in account. Users have a limited number of likes.

followButton.agent_instructions: Click to follow the project and receive notifications about updates.

commentInput.description: Write a comment on the project
commentInput.agent_instructions: Type a comment and submit to join the community discussion about this project. Requires a logged-in account.

suggestedActions.description: Search for projects by keyword via the API
Submit a new project for AI-powered analysis and community listing
Subscribe to email digests for new projects in specific categories
View full details for a specific project
